limitations: Headless cloud Chromium and emulated touch viewport, not physical mobile hardware or rendered FPS.
Native wall time and allocation are not browser CPU shares; elapsed timers include runtime/scheduling.
Parent timings include children; do not sum inclusive rows.
Native profiles use 3 independent worlds per scenario; browser far 5x runs repeated twice, other cases once.
Focused probe ran faster than independent uninstrumented runs; not negative overhead or an optimization.
Save capture duration includes cooperative yielding and a simulation pause.
Flat-grass stress fixture retains original vegetation and restores forests during the first yearly plant pass.
A failed initial near-view navigation produced no performance report; retained in production-browser.log.
